refusal_bucket_is_an_upper_bound: GROUPED BY STATUS TEXT, SO THIS BUCKET CANNOT DISTINGUISH a genuine execution-boundary refusal from a refusal that was REPLACED by the boundary status. Measured 2026-11-03 (73975e2): _serve_by_acting overwrites any failure class that _is_honest_contract_refusal does not recognise, so a precise refusal could reach a caller wearing the confinement status without the boundary having been consulted at all. Four such cases were found and fixed in one file. Read the 189 (117 of them carrying the confinement status) as an UPPER BOUND on 'blocked on a review', never as a count. See FRONT_DOOR_BINDING_FIX_20261103_V1.md.
